column1: # Canonical cell-dump SHA-256 per input file. The reader must reproduce each
# hash exactly. Hashes only - the dumps themselves are real student PII and are
# never committed. parser/cmd/dumpcells prints the stream a hash is taken over,
# which is how a failure is narrowed from a file to a cell.
# FROZEN. These cannot be regenerated, so a mismatch is a reader bug until
# proven otherwise, never a cue to refresh this file. Any change to the reader
# that alters a single cell of any input listed below fails the suite. If the
# inputs themselves ever change, re-derive only the affected rows, deliberately
